purpose: Form language board — showing the evolution from natural pebble/drop/seashell forms to the final product's organic continuous-curve design
prompt:
Form language design board for an AI companion device inspired by natural organic forms. Professional industrial design presentation on matte cloud white (#E8E4DF) background.

LEFT SECTION — Natural references: Three organic natural forms arranged vertically:
1. A smooth river pebble — asymmetric oval, continuous curvature, warm gray-white
2. A water drop — gentle teardrop silhouette, smooth tension surface
3. A seashell — soft spiral curves, organic asymmetry

CENTER SECTION — Silhouette evolution: A progression showing how the natural forms translate into product design curves. Sketch-style line drawings showing:
- Organic contour lines extracted from natural references
- Curve analysis with smooth curvature graphs
- Proportion studies showing height-to-width ratio ~1:1.3

RIGHT SECTION — Final product form: The resolved product design in warm ceramic white (#F2EDE8) with soft warm gray (#D4CFC9) accents. Multiple angle views showing the continuous smooth surfaces, no sharp edges, all transitions flowing. The organic pebble form realized as a product.

Clean structured layout, mix of sketch and render. Professional industrial design exploration sheet. Warm neutral palette. No geometric or angular forms anywhere.
negative_prompt: geometric, angular, sharp edges, boxy, cylindrical, perfect sphere, pure black, cold white, high saturation, messy, cyberpunk, medical, glossy metallic, random gradients
